summary: Implementation plan for Task 7.1: Three-Way Ablation Benchmark (PyPDF vs. Docling Text/Table vs. OmniDoc-Vision) across 30 golden multimodal QA pairs, computing Table Cell F1-Score, Visual Chart QA Accuracy, Context Recall@5, Faithfulness, and P95 Latency (Fast Path vs. Visual Path), and outputting JSON/Markdown reports to evals/results/ plus unit tests in tests/unit/test_multimodal_benchmark.py.
